profileLabel: Mixed economics; mixed-to-institution-supporting on accountability bills (medium-low confidence)
summary: Bacolod representative with 39 principal-authored bills. Authored zero-balance billing under Universal Health Care, re-establishing the PCGG as an anti-corruption commission, digitized asset declarations, and a bill postponing the November 2026 barangay and SK elections. Also authored real property tax capping and an online-hate penalty bill.
caveat: The postponement bill and the accountability bills pull in opposite directions; the +1 score reflects that mix. Online-hate bill not scored alone. No votes reviewed.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Zero-balance billing under universal health care (-3) against real property tax capping and amnesty (+1) and a co-authored private higher-education voucher (+2). Balanced pattern.
